text:
Maria K.: Heads up — I'm about to change keystore RBAC (keystore-reader -> keystore-decrypt) and update the KMS unwrap policy for cross-region proxies. Want a quick sanity-check on mTLS + cert chain behavior before we flip.
Devin L.: what's the exact policy delta? can we do a canary first? :eyes:
Maria K.: Policy diff: removed broad project/wide decrypt for keystore service account, replaced with explicit key resource ARNs and condition on request.region. Also tightened IAM binding TTL. snippet:```json
{"role":"roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyDecrypter","members":["serviceAccount:keystore@redwood-prod.iam.gserviceaccount.com"],"condition":{"expression":"resource.name.startsWith('projects/redwood/locations/*/keyRings/keystore')"}}```
Devin L.: ok canary -> pick eu-west-1 proxy and ap-south-1 as canaries? cross-region unwraps are the risky ones.
Maria K.: yes — will route 1% of traffic from eu->apac to the new policy. request window ~20m.
security-bot: ALERT: 1763871302 - KMS.DecryptAccessDenied spike on ap-south-1 -> 14 failures in last 2m. (autodetected)
Omar R.: seeing handshake errors from edge-proxy in ap-south-1: "TLS handshake failed: remote error: handshake failure" in the proxy logs. quick log:```
2026-06-12T09:04:12Z proxy[edge-004]: tls: failed to get key material: KMS.DecryptAccessDenied
2026-06-12T09:04:12Z proxy[edge-004]: tls: handshake error with 10.12.34.56: remote error
```
Ida S.: is this correlated with the RBAC change window?
Maria K.: yes rolled the new binding at 09:02 UTC. canary shows deny.
Devin L.: hypothesis: key resource naming mismatch across regions (we scoped to locations/* but proxies request locations/ap-south-1/cryptoKeyVersions/...). Need to confirm key ARNs in policy.
Omar R.: quick grep shows proxy was using key version path without the keyRing segment in apac region — airflow config drift from the old deploy.
Maria K.: okay revert plan: re-add temporary decrypt for keystore service account with a condition on timestamp + region exclude for ap-south-1, then iterate on strict ARNs. Can someone push the revert?
Devin L.: I'll push a scoped allow for 30m and mark it as emergency. command I will run:```bash
gcloud iam roles add-iam-policy-binding --project=redwood-prod --role=roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyDecrypter --member=serviceAccount:keystore@redwood-prod.iam.gserviceaccount.com --condition='expression=request.time < timestamp("2026-06-12T09:50:00Z")'
```
security-bot: NOTE: Audit log matcher: use filter `protoPayload.methodName="google.cloud.kms.v1.KeyManagementService.Decrypt" AND resource.labels.location="ap-south-1"` to enumerate denies.
Ida S.: also check proxy keystore cache TTL — if proxies fail to unwrap the cert they may continue trying session-resume repeatedly and amplify errors. reduce retry backoff for canary.
Omar R.: found root cause: ap-south deploy's keystore config referenced `projects/redwood/locations/ap-south-1/keyRings/keystore/cryptoKeys/edge-key` while the new policy used wildcard `locations/*/keyRings/keystore` but our IAM condition used `resource.name.startsWith('projects/redwood/locations/*/keyRings/keystore')` which fails because the proxy's request uses the cryptoKeyVersion resource name (it includes `/cryptoKeyVersions/1`). condition mismatch.
Maria K.: ugh. fix = change condition to match `contains('/keyRings/keystore/cryptoKeys/edge-key')` or better: grant on the key resource `projects/redwood/locations/*/keyRings/keystore/cryptoKeys/edge-key`.
Devin L.: will apply revert + narrower grant. After that we should validate: 1) mTLS handshakes succeed 2) audit logs show successful Decrypt events 3) no spike in handshake latency.
security-bot: ALERT: 1763872000 - cert rotation job in eu-west-1 failed earlier (job id: cert-rot-22) - linked to KMS.DecryptAccessDenied. Recommend stalling scheduled rotations for other regions until canary is clean.
Maria K.: good call, pausing rotations. Omar — can you run `gcloud logging read "protoPayload.methodName=\"google.cloud.kms.v1.KeyManagementService.Decrypt\" AND resource.labels.location=\"ap-south-1\"" --limit 50 --project=redwood-prod` and paste a sample deny?
Omar R.: pasted a sample in thread.
Devin L.: once revert is applied I'm going to run the following validation script against edge-proxy:```bash
# quick mtls probe
curl --resolve edge.redwood.com:443:10.12.34.56 https://edge.redwood.com/healthz --cert /tmp/test.crt --key /tmp/test.key -v
```
Ida S.: also check TLS config: we still allow TLS1.2 for legacy clients. if we see clients failing post-fix, could be that some intermediates are using TLS1.2 + session tickets that depend on the keystore. consider temporarily allowing TLS1.2 for backward compat in ap-south until rotation finishes.
Maria K.: action items: Devin -> push scoped revert grant (in 2m). Omar -> run audit log queries & sample deny entries. Ida -> hold rotations + adjust retry backoff on canary proxies. I'll follow up with a postmortem note listing the IAM condition pattern we used and a template policy for cross-region unwraps.
Devin L.: revert applied at 09:18 UTC. monitoring now. :thumbsup:
security-bot: UPDATE: 1763872500 - KMS.DecryptAccessDenied reduced to 0 in ap-south-1 after revert.
Omar R.: handshakes restored, no regression in latency seen in the next 15m.
Maria K.: great. postmortem checklist: - record the condition mismatch - add unit test for policy vs resource.name patterns - add audit-alert runbook for KMS denies that ties to cert rotations - schedule a follow-up to harden TLS ciphers and session ticket handling across regions.
Ida S.: I'll own the follow-up, propose Wednesday sync.
Maria K.: thanks everyone. will file the incident ticket and link this thread. :white_check_mark:
